cases.question: How many paid vacation days does a full-time employee receive each year?
cases.reference_answer: Full-time employees receive 24 paid vacation days per calendar year.
forbidden_claims: unused vacation always carries over automatically
cases.notes: Annual leave entitlement with a grounded forbidden claim.

cases.question: My vacation request is for six consecutive workdays. Whose approval is required?
cases.reference_answer: A vacation request longer than five consecutive working days requires manager approval.
cases.notes: Applies a stated threshold to a six-day request.

cases.question: Do unused vacation days automatically roll into next year?
cases.reference_answer: No. Unused vacation does not automatically carry over unless HR grants an exception.

cases.question: What documentation is needed after being sick for four consecutive working days?
cases.reference_answer: Medical documentation is required after more than three consecutive working days of absence.

cases.question: What are NovaTech's normal weekday working hours and lunch break?
cases.reference_answer: Normal hours are Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM, with a one-hour lunch break.

cases.question: How long is the usual probation period for a new full-time hire?
cases.reference_answer: The usual probation period is three months unless the employment agreement says otherwise.

cases.question: What is the weekly maximum for working remotely?
cases.reference_answer: Employees may work remotely up to three days per week with direct-manager approval of the schedule.

cases.question: Who must approve my regular work-from-home schedule?
cases.reference_answer: Your direct manager must approve the remote-work schedule.

cases.question: I want to work from another country for 12 straight calendar days. What approval do I need?
cases.reference_answer: Working from another country for more than 10 consecutive calendar days requires written HR approval.

cases.question: While remote, when must I be reachable and through what kind of tools?
cases.reference_answer: Remote employees must be reachable through approved company communication tools during normal working hours.

cases.question: Which computer should I use for company work when the company has issued me one?
cases.reference_answer: Use the company-issued laptop for company work when it is available.

cases.question: What is the minimum number of characters for a company password?
cases.reference_answer: Company passwords must contain at least 14 characters.

cases.question: May I tell a coworker my company password?
cases.reference_answer: No. Company passwords must not be shared with other employees.

cases.question: Which company accounts require multi-factor authentication?
cases.reference_answer: MFA is required for all company accounts that support it.

cases.question: Are shared admin accounts allowed without IT Security approval?
cases.reference_answer: No. Shared administrative accounts are prohibited unless specifically approved by IT Security.

cases.question: After how much inactivity must a company computer lock itself?
cases.reference_answer: A company computer must automatically lock after 10 minutes of inactivity.

cases.question: What should I do immediately if my company laptop is stolen?
cases.reference_answer: Report a lost or stolen company device to the IT Service Desk immediately.

cases.question: When does health insurance enrollment begin for an eligible full-time employee?
cases.reference_answer: Eligible full-time employees enroll after completing 30 days of employment.

cases.question: How much annual wellness allowance does a full-time employee get?
cases.reference_answer: Full-time employees receive USD 500 annually for approved fitness, wellbeing, or ergonomic expenses.

cases.question: What is my yearly professional development budget, and is approval needed before reimbursement?
cases.reference_answer: A full-time employee receives USD 1,200 per year, and manager approval is required before reimbursement.

cases.question: Is dental coverage part of the standard benefits package for eligible full-time staff?
cases.reference_answer: Yes. Dental coverage is available to eligible full-time employees as part of the standard benefits package.

cases.question: Can qualifying dependents be added to supported insurance plans?
cases.reference_answer: Eligible employees may add qualifying dependents, subject to the insurer's rules.

cases.question: What setup steps should a new employee perform after receiving temporary laptop credentials?
cases.reference_answer: Sign in with the temporary credentials, immediately change the password, and enroll in MFA.

cases.question: The VPN still fails after I restarted the client. What remaining troubleshooting should I try?
cases.reference_answer: Re-authenticate with MFA, restart the computer, and contact the IT Service Desk if the issue continues.
cases.notes: Starts midway through the documented sequence.

cases.question: When accessing internal systems away from a NovaTech office, what connection is required?
cases.reference_answer: Employees outside a NovaTech office must use the company VPN to access internal systems.

cases.question: Where should I get approved software when a packaged version exists?
cases.reference_answer: Install it through the company software portal when an approved package is available.

cases.question: How many other engineers must approve a production code change before merge?
cases.reference_answer: At least one other engineer must review and approve it before merging.

cases.question: Can engineers push straight to main?
cases.reference_answer: No. Direct pushes to main are prohibited; changes must use an approved pull request.

cases.question: Should a pull request be merged while mandatory CI checks are failing?
cases.reference_answer: No. Pull requests should not be merged when required CI checks are failing.

cases.question: What credentials are forbidden from being committed to source control?
cases.reference_answer: API keys, passwords, access tokens, and private credentials must never be committed.

cases.question: What must happen before a normal production deployment, and what follows an emergency change?
cases.reference_answer: Mandatory CI checks must pass before production deployment, and emergency changes must be documented afterward.

cases.question: Give examples of information NovaTech classifies as confidential.
cases.reference_answer: Examples include non-public financial information, customer data, security details, private source code, and sensitive business plans.

cases.question: Who may receive confidential company information?
cases.reference_answer: Only people authorized to access it who have a legitimate business need.

cases.question: What kinds of information are Restricted, and how is access granted?
cases.reference_answer: Restricted information includes authentication secrets, private cryptographic keys, and highly sensitive regulated data; access must be explicitly authorized.

cases.question: What is the daily meal limit on approved business travel?
cases.reference_answer: Reasonable meal expenses are capped at USD 60 per day unless a local policy sets another limit.

cases.question: For a $30 taxi expense on approved business travel, is it reimbursable and is a receipt required?
cases.reference_answer: A reasonable taxi expense may be reimbursed, and a receipt is required because the individual expense is at least USD 25.
cases.notes: Combines transportation eligibility with the receipt threshold.

cases.question: Can I paste confidential private source code into ChatGPT?
cases.notes: Classification does not establish service approval.
